meta_title: S B Decorating Services | Painter & Decorator Birmingham
meta_description: S B Decorating Services in Birmingham offers interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and full decoration. Free quotes, expert finish guaranteed.
hero_subhead: From feature walls to complete room transformations, we deliver a flawless finish on time and within budget.
services_subhead: Whether you need interior redecorating, exterior paintwork, or specialist finishes, we handle every detail with care.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decoration
services.desc: Transform your living spaces with precision brushwork and premium paints. We prep surfaces properly and deliver a finish that lasts.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Professional hanging of wallpaper, vinyl, and textured coverings. Pattern matching and perfect alignment guaranteed on every wall.

services.title: Exterior Paintwork
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior painting for fascias, soffits, doors, and cladding. We use quality exterior grades to protect your home year-round.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery
services.desc: Expert sanding, staining, and painting of skirting boards, doors, shutters, and fitted furniture. Smooth, professional finishes.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accent Colours
services.desc: Create impact with bold colours, murals, or textured finishes. We help you choose the right shade and apply it flawlessly.

services.title: Commercial Decoration
services.desc: Full redecoration for offices, shops, and commercial properties. Efficient scheduling to minimise disruption to your business.

about_pullquote: I believe in doing the job once, properly, so you never need to call again.
about_para_1: S B Decorating Services has been transforming homes and businesses across Birmingham and Walsall for over two decades. Founded on the principle that quality preparation and attention to detail matter more than speed, we've built a reputation for delivering finishes that look fresh for years. Every project begins with a thorough site visit and honest assessment—no hidden costs or cowboy shortcuts.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we listen to what you actually want, keep the job site clean and tidy, and finish on schedule. We take pride in the craftsmanship that goes unseen—proper surface prep, the right primer, expert technique—because that's what separates a room that looks great from one that looks immaculate.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had S B in to redecorate our lounge and bedroom. From the first visit, they were professional and honest about costs. The prep work was thorough, and the finish is absolutely first-class. Two years on, it still looks pristine. Can't recommend them highly enough.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Nightmare with our kitchen—water damage meant we needed emergency repainting. Called S B on a Friday afternoon and they came out Saturday morning. Sorted it brilliantly, colour matched perfectly, and the price was fair. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Wallpapered our hallway and painted the stairs and landing. Lovely lads, kept everything clean, left no mess. The wallpaper is perfectly hung—no bubbles, no crooked seams. They even moved furniture and put it back. Very impressed with the attention to detail.
reviews.author: David R.
